messages:
Iris N.: Quick question - installing redwoodctl via our internal RPM repo on Fedora 38 fails with SELinux AVC denials during postinstall. `rpm --install redwoodctl-0.9.4.x86_64.rpm` completes but `redwoodctl --version` gives permission denied. Anyone seen SELinux blocked syscalls?

Ben K.: Yep saw that on RHEL. Postinstall script creates /usr/libexec/redwood and a symlink in /usr/bin. If the %post runs without an SELinux fcontext update, exec permission gets denied. Check `ausearch -m avc -ts recent` for denials.\
Iris N.: Here's the AVC I got:
```
type=AVC msg=audit(1670000000.000:123): avc:  denied  { execute } for  pid=1234 comm="redwoodctl" name="redwoodctl" dev="sda1" ino=5678 scontext=system_u:system_r:unconfined_service_t:s0 tcontext=unconfined_u:object_r:usr_t:s0 tclass=file
```

Ben K.: Fixes that worked for us: (1) in RPM %post run `semanage fcontext -a -t usr_t '/usr/libexec/redwood(/.*)?' && restorecon -Rv /usr/libexec/redwood` and (2) create symlink with correct context: `ln -s /usr/libexec/redwood/redwoodctl /usr/bin/redwoodctl` then `restorecon /usr/bin/redwoodctl`. Also add `%triggerpostun` to clean labels on uninstall.

Iris N.: Thanks, workaround applied and verified. Filing a ticket to update our package scripts.

Ben K.: Slightly related: we still have a weird config/profile edge-case where duplicates cause login to attach token to the wrong profile. We had a user migrate dotfiles and ended up with two `[profile]` tables both with `name = "default"`. `redwoodctl login --profile default` updated the first one, but the desired endpoint was in the second.

Iris N.: Repro steps for ops: create two profile tables with same name but different `endpoint` and run login. Observed token persisted to first table always.

Ben K.: Short-term CI workaround: set `REDWOODCTL_CONFIG=/tmp/rdw-config` per job so you get a clean file. Long-term fix: require unique profile ids on create and warn on duplicate names. I'll file an issue.

Ops-bot: New issue created: #2620 "rpm/selinux: fix postinstall fcontext + config: duplicate profile name causes login ambiguity" by Ben K. https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/2620

Iris N.: One last thing: when running `redwoodctl dev --local` in our headless build agents it spawns browser SSO and the job hangs. We used `--token-file` but it errored when the file had 600 perms (owner-only) because the agent runs as a different user. Need clearer docs for `--token-file` perms and a `--no-browser --token-stdin` pair for CI.

Ben K.: Agreed. Also auth retries are currently fixed to 3 attempts and exponential backoff; with our parallel runners we hit IdP 429s. Proposing env knobs `REDWOODCTL_AUTH_RETRIES` and `REDWOODCTL_AUTH_BACKOFF_MS` and a `--auth-serial` toggle to serialize logins on a host.

Iris N.: I'll add the RPM SELinux notes and CI token guidance to our onboarding doc. Thanks!

redwoodctl-bot: Acknowledged. Assigned to packaging and cli teams.
